author: jombo.uk
name: LFG
short: Private cog for Straftat Discord Server.
description: Allows users to post LFG messages pinging the Matchmaking role, restricted to a specific channel and a cooldown.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores the timestamp and details of each user's last LFG post to enforce cooldowns and power the /lfgupdate command.
